title: 巴克莱邵炯：国际机会被低估，阿里云海外占比约10%
speaker: Jiong Shao

segments.en: It's a great point. I think the international opportunity is the one that's most underappreciated by the investors in the US and possibly in Europe.
segments.zh: 说得好。我认为国际机会最被美国和欧洲市场低估。

segments.en: But they are already appreciated by the actual users of these AI models, whether or not you are a large enterprises.
segments.zh: 但实际使用这些AI模型的用户已经认识到其价值，无论你是大型企业还是初创公司。

segments.en: You know, for a fact, many large US enterprises are using the Babas Queen model or other Chinese open source models, and startups are using these models as well.
segments.zh: 事实上，许多美国大型企业正在使用阿里通义千问或其他中国开源模型，初创公司也在使用。

segments.en: Because the cost for these models is what? 5%-3% of the anthropocardial open-air models.
segments.zh: 因为这些模型的成本仅为Anthropic或OpenAI模型的3%到5%。

segments.en: So we see the international business opportunity should be very, very significant for both Ari Baba and for Tencent.
segments.zh: 因此我们认为国际业务机会对阿里和腾讯都非常重要。

segments.en: And for Baba, we estimate already less than 10%, or roughly 10% of the AI cloud business is coming from internationally.
segments.zh: 对阿里而言，我们估计目前AI云业务中来自国际的占比不到10%，约10%。

segments.en: But Middle East, Southeast Asia, Europe can be very, very sizable market for these companies.
segments.zh: 但中东、东南亚、欧洲对这些公司来说可能是非常大的市场。

segments.en: So we see over time, investors will increasingly appreciate the value, the Babas over the world, the Zida AI, the Moonshot, the Mini Max.
segments.zh: 因此我们认为，随着时间推移，市场会越来越认可阿里、智谱AI、月之暗面、MiniMax等公司的价值。
